All 5 pytest cases pass; frontend widget + admin theme + payroll toasts verified.
critical_code_review_comments: uk_payroll._notify: 'mode' is derived from email_st only for the emails branch ('sent' in email_st or 'sent' in wa_st) — logic is correct; note that when there are no recipients emails=0 but delivery still returns mode='mock' which is intended.

booking_widget check-availability: computes ota_total = total_rate / (1 - direct_pct/100). Safe against divide-by-zero (guarded 0 < direct_pct < 100). For pct outside range falls back to ota_total==direct_total — acceptable.

widget stay_signals returns only one item per icon kind (via `seen` set on icons) — matches requirement; deduplication is by category-mapped icon, so two 'sport' events would collapse to one. This is intentional guest-facing simplification.
seed_data_creation: No seed created. Payroll April 2026 run touched: correction-request (Bildirim testi) → decide reject, then unlock (test unlock), then re-lock. Left locked at end as instructed. Restored booking_widget_config.direct_advantage_pct back to 5 after PUT to 8/7.
